messages.cannotBeUsed: The computed property cannot be used in `data()` because it is before initialization.

cases.code:
<script lang="ts">
      export default {
        data() {
          const foo = this.foo
          return {}
        }
      }
      </script>

<script lang="ts">
      export default {
        data() {
          const foo = this.foo()
          return {}
        },
        methods: {
          foo() {}
        }
      }
      </script>

<script lang="ts">
      export default {
        props: ['foo'],
        data() {
          const foo = this.foo
          return {}
        },
      }
      </script>

<script lang="ts">
      export default {
        data: {
          foo: this.foo
        },
        computed: {
          foo () {}
        }
      }
      </script>

<script lang="ts">
      export default {
        data() {
          const foo = this.foo
          return  {}
        },
        computed: {
          foo () {}
        }
      }
      </script>
